header.title: Multi Randomizer
header.tagline: Randomize items, enemies and fog gates of Dark Souls Remastered.

startupError.text: DS1 Multi Randomizer could not start its engine. Close and reopen the app; if it keeps happening, download the app again.

preset.placeholder: Paste a DS1TR preset here, or export the current settings.
preset.exported: Preset exported. Copy the text to share these settings.
preset.applied: Preset applied. Review the settings, then click Generate world.
preset.problemsLead: The preset could not be applied. Technical details (in English):

state.vanilla: Your game is original and ready to be randomized.
state.active: A randomized game is applied. Restore the original game before making a new one.
state.interrupted: A previous change was interrupted. Click "Restore original game" to repair it.
state.version-changed: Dark Souls Remastered was updated. Restore the original game files, then try again.
state.modified: Some game files were changed by another tool. Verify the game files in Steam first.
state.invalid: This folder is not a Dark Souls Remastered installation.

run.chooseSettings: Choose your settings, then click Generate world.
run.stale: You changed the settings after this world was created. Apply installs the world shown above; Generate world creates a new one.
run.pendingRestore: To create the shared world, restore the original game first. It is created automatically afterwards.
run.pendingRepair: To create the shared world, repair the game first. It is created automatically afterwards.
run.pendingBlocked: The shared world is created as soon as your game is ready.

message.seedCopyFailed: Select the seed code and copy it with Ctrl+C.
message.planDone: Pipeline plan generated. Planned extensions remain disabled until implemented.

main.title: Main options
main.note: The most important settings of the randomizer.

dlc.title: DLC content
dlc.note: Turns the randomization of the Artorias of the Abyss content on or off.

output.title: Result file
output.note: A text file that lists what was randomized.
output.warning: The file can reveal the locations of important items, bosses and passages. Open it only if you want to know the result.

advancedView.title: Advanced mode
advancedView.note: All options with full descriptions. Select ? next to an option for a detailed explanation.

game.note: Randomize items, enemies and transitions in Dark Souls Remastered.

presets.title: Presets
presets.note: Your settings, ready to save, share or restore.
presets.explain: The settings you see in Your game are the current preset. Export them as text in Import / Export, or return to the recommended settings here.
presets.presetText: Only settings. Applying a preset changes the options and creates nothing; every generation afterwards makes a new world with a new random seed.
presets.seedText: One exact world: the settings and the seed together. Loading a Seed Code puts its settings in the options and generates that same world straight away.

transfer.title: Import / Export
transfer.note: Move settings between computers as text.
transfer.noSeed: A preset never contains a seed, so it never recreates a particular world. Use a Seed Code for that.

seed.title: Seed Code
seed.note: Share an exact world or recreate one.
seed.none: No world has been generated yet. After you generate one, its Seed Code appears here.
seed.loadExplain: Paste a code. Its settings are put in the options of your game, and the world is generated automatically (the original game is restored first when needed).
seed.whatText: The generation profile, the master seed and every setting that decides a world. It does not contain your language, the Basic or Advanced view or your game folder. The same code makes the same world with the same generation profile.

settings.title: App settings
settings.languageNote: The language of this app. It never changes a world and is not part of a Seed Code.

update.title: Updates
update.note: DS1 Multi Randomizer looks for new versions on GitHub. Nothing is installed without your click, and a failed check never stops you from using the app.
update.autoCheckNote: Checks at most once a day while the app is open. Turn it off to check only by hand.
update.portableNote: Portable version must be updated manually: download the new version, then replace this file.
update.ready: Update ready. DS1 Multi Randomizer {{version}} starts after the restart.
update.blocked: Finish the current operation before updating.

errors.CHECK_FAILED: Unable to check for updates. You can keep using the app.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Unable to download update. You can keep using the app and try again.
errors.INSTALL_FAILED: The update could not be started. You can keep using the app.
errors.OPERATION_ACTIVE: Finish the current operation before updating.
errors.INVALID_STATE: That is not possible right now.
errors.NOT_SUPPORTED: This version must be updated manually.

unsupported.development: Updates are checked only in the installed app, not in a development run.
unsupported.no-update-source: This build has no update source, so it does not check for updates.
